MONITORS.TITLE: Monitors
MONITORS.CUSTOM_RANGE_HELP: Choose a range of 7 to 30 days, including the start and end dates.
MONITORS.PAUSED_HELP: Paused on {time}. Historical results remain available. New messages and conversations are not being checked.
MONITORS.RESULTS_UPDATED: New results are available. The chart has been refreshed; select a bar to view its updated conversations.
MONITORS.TIME_BASIS_HELP: Each conversation counts once, on the date it was created. A new match can update an earlier bar.
MONITORS.COVERAGE_HELP: This range includes periods that were not fully checked. Counts may be incomplete.
MONITORS.REFRESHED: Last refreshed at {time}. Updates appear automatically.

USAGE.LIMIT_REACHED: This account has used its {limit} monitor calls for this month.
USAGE.RESETS: New evaluations and previews are on hold until {time}. Existing results remain available.

STATES.rechecking: Rechecking conversations with the updated description

ERRORS.fetch_failed: Could not load this monitor. Refresh to try again.
ERRORS.save_failed: Could not save the monitor. Check the name and condition, then try again.
ERRORS.not_configured: Monitors need an OpenRouter connection. Ask your installation administrator to configure it.
ERRORS.credentials_invalid: The OpenRouter connection needs attention. Ask your installation administrator to check its credentials.
ERRORS.provider_credits_exhausted: The OpenRouter account has insufficient credits. Ask your installation administrator to check its balance, then retry.
ERRORS.invalid_request: The evaluation request needs attention. Contact your installation administrator.
ERRORS.invalid_response: The evaluation provider returned an incomplete result. Affected conversations have not been counted.
ERRORS.provider_busy: The evaluation provider is busy. Pending conversations need another evaluation.
ERRORS.provider_unavailable: The evaluation provider is temporarily unavailable. Updates may be delayed.
ERRORS.rate_limit: Evaluation is waiting for available capacity.
ERRORS.budget_limit: The daily evaluation allowance has been reached. Pending work will resume after it resets.
ERRORS.monthly_limit: This account has reached its monthly monitor allowance. Pending evaluations will resume next month.
ERRORS.context_limit: Some conversations are too long to evaluate completely. They are excluded from the results.
ERRORS.no_text: Some conversations do not have public text to evaluate. They are excluded from the results.
ERRORS.invalid_parameters: Check the name, condition, date range, and interval.
ERRORS.too_many_buckets: Choose a shorter date range or a larger interval. A chart can show up to 744 bars.
ERRORS.monitor_limit: This account has reached its active monitor limit. Pause a monitor before creating another.
ERRORS.monitor_paused: This monitor is paused and no longer checks conversations.
ERRORS.monitor_changed: This monitor changed in another session. Its current state has been refreshed. Try again.
